title: Flighty UI Clone
role: End-to-end planning, design analysis, Figma redesign, and frontend development
introduction: A Vue 3 clone of Flighty’s main screens. I used 32 flight records for the list, details, search, map, passport, and statistics screens, with responsive layouts, language options, and unit settings.
myWorks: Captured the Flighty 4.8.2 desktop UI and analyzed IA, typography hierarchy, card structure, and interaction density
Built responsive screens and shared UI components with Vue 3, Vite, and Vue Router based on the final Figma design
Connected 32 flights through shared JSON so list, detail, search, passport, and statistics views use consistent data
Implemented route maps with MapLibre and OpenFreeMap, synchronized with search, period selection, and flight-detail context
Persisted device language, Korean, English, Japanese, and distance, speed, and altitude unit settings across the app
achievements: Centralized time, delay, timezone, and statistics calculations so every flight view shares consistent results
Completed a reusable publishing architecture by separating base UI from Flighty-specific composed components and prop variants
points: Route maps and aircraft details filtered by search and date
Responsive layouts, four languages, and unit conversion
